olivia_partner: Hey CS/eng - onboarding DeltaStream. Mobile SDK v2.0.4 + server-side proxy. Seeing bursts of 429s on preflight and occasional 403s from our proxy when traffic ramps after deploy. Any quick remedial steps?

quentin_cs: Hi @olivia_partner! Can you confirm whether the 403s are from your proxy or from api.redwood-inference.com? If from the proxy, share its auth logs.

olivia_partner: 403s come from our proxy (proxy-auth failed). Preflight 429s are direct from api.redwood-inference.com/v1/preflight. Example preflight body: {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":10}. x-request-id: req_DS_77.

nora_eng: Two concurrent issues: (1) proxy auth failing under burst -> causes retries that fan out to preflight; (2) preflight rate window hit because clients all refresh at once. For the proxy, check mTLS cert rotation timing and whether the proxy caches short-lived tokens.

olivia_partner: We rotate certs via CI each deploy and the proxy restarts, which may cause a small auth gap. Proxy also creates a new ephemeral token per upstream request.

quentin_cs: That explains it. Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) make proxy reuse a cached ephemeral token for N seconds after issuance; 2) add jitter to client refresh on resume/deploy; 3) implement a semaphore on proxy to limit concurrent preflight calls to backend (suggest 4); 4) honor Retry-After and backoff with full jitter.

nora_eng: Server-side help: we can enable per-org preflight coalescing and a temporary onboarding burst increase for a migration window. Share org id and expected concurrent upstream requests. Also provide the x-request-id and timestamp for the 403s so we can correlate logs.

olivia_partner: org_Delta-9. Expect ~350 concurrent mobile clients over ~90s during staged rollout. 403 x-request-id: prox_403_A7 at 2025-03-10T21:05:12Z.

edge-bot: edge-bot: observed elevated 429s in eu-west-1 near 2025-03-10T21:05:00Z for preflight endpoints.

ci-bot: ci-bot: proxy deployment for delta-proxy succeeded @ 2025-03-10T21:04:55Z

quentin_cs: Looks like proxy restart aligns with spike. Quick patch: modify proxy to warm a token before cutover and drain existing connections (graceful restart). Also add a tiny startup jitter on clients so they don't all reconnect instantly.

nora_eng: I'll open CS-5012 to request a 6-hour onboarding quota bump to 1500 r/min and to enable preflight coalescing for org_Delta-9 in eu-west-1. Meanwhile, Olivia, add a 10s token cache and limit concurrent upstream calls. Example pseudo: 

```
// proxy token cache (pseudo)
let tokenCache = { token: null, expiry: 0 }
async function getToken() {
  if (Date.now() < tokenCache.expiry - 5000) return tokenCache.token
  tokenCache.token = await fetchEphemeralToken()
  tokenCache.expiry = Date.now() + 60*1000 // reuse for 60s
  return tokenCache.token
}
```

olivia_partner: Implementing token cache + graceful restarts now. Will run a canary at 10% and report back in 20m. Thanks all!
